mapper.select: SELECT o.*, c.customer_name, w.warehouse_name, u1.real_name as salesman_name, u2.real_name as approver_name, d.dept_name FROM biz_sale_order o LEFT JOIN biz_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN biz_warehouse w ON o.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON o.salesman_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON o.approver_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON o.dept_id = d.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM biz_sale_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status >= 1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount - received_amount), 0) FROM biz_sale_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2)
